summary: Stormy Lake fire tower in Restoule Provincial Park, built 1954 and about 30 m tall; the park plan says it would need upgrades before opening to the public.

access.note: The Fire Tower Trail is promoted for hiking. The park plan says the tower would need extensive upgrading before it could open as a public viewing tower. No source found describes it as open to climbers.

visit.trail_note: The Fire Tower Trail starts at a picnic area just west of the park road and is a sometimes challenging climb to the top of the Stormy Lake Bluffs.

events.note: Stormy Lake fire tower, per the provincial park management plan. The only build date found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The plan says over 30 metres; Wikipedia gives 100 feet (30 m). Recorded as 30 m.

notes_for_editor: The 1954 build date rests on one source: the provincial park management plan, which has a 2002 copyright line. Its own date was not checked further. The plan calls the tower the Stormy Lake fire tower; the record name is Restoule Fire Tower. Consider listing the Stormy Lake name as an alias. Height: the plan says over 30 metres, Wikipedia says 100 ft (30 m); recorded as 30 m. Access 'restricted' is inferred from the plan's upgrading comment and the absence of any source saying the tower is open to climbers. No current park notice was checked. No builder, design or staffing source was found. No photos.
